item.title: The Picasso code
item.description: Recently, I have been reviewing the following JavaScript code, and I found so many issues that I have decided to discuss them here. First of all, I am not trying to embarrass anyone, so I am not mentioning where this comes from. With this post, I want to use bad examples to promote and remind all of us, including myself, to use common sense and best practices when it comes to writing new code.
